sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I'm Gemma Spake, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 我是 Gemma Spake，欢迎回到《20 多岁的心理学》，这是一档探讨我们 20 多岁时所经历的最大变化、重要时刻和人生转折的播客，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及这些经历对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到这档播客。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们今天的收听。

sentences.en: I have more of a chatty episode for you than we usually do.
sentences.zh: 这一期节目会比我们平时的内容更像是一次闲聊。

sentences.en: I kind of just wanted to share, chat, muse over something
sentences.zh: 我只是想分享、交流、思考一些事情，

sentences.en: I've been psychoanalyzing a lot in myself recently just to see if any of you relate and see if any of you feel the same way.
sentences.zh: 这些是我最近一直在自我剖析的内容，想看看你们是否也有共鸣，是否也有同样的感受。

sentences.en: And that is my relationship with ambition and how that is changing as I enter my late 20s.
sentences.zh: 那就是我与“野心”的关系，以及随着我步入 20 多岁后期，这种关系是如何变化的。

sentences.en: As long as I can remember, and as long as I have been, I guess, a person with a personality and a memory,
sentences.zh: 在我有记忆以来，或者说在我拥有个性和记忆以来，

sentences.en: I have been an ambitious person.
sentences.zh: 我一直是一个有野心的人。

sentences.en: And what I mean by ambitious is that
sentences.zh: 我所说的野心是指，

sentences.en: I think I've been somebody who wanted lots from life and who was really okay with the hard work that it might take to get there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我是一个对生活有很多追求，并且非常愿意为实现这些目标而付出艰苦努力的人。

sentences.en: And even when I was a kid, you know, I don't think people would have used the word ambitious, but they certainly used words like that were pretty similar.
sentences.zh: 即使在我小时候，你知道，我不认为人们会用“野心勃勃”这个词来形容我，但他们肯定用过非常相似的词。

sentences.en: You know, I think people would have described me as very stubborn and enthusiastic and maybe a perfectionist and goal-driven.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得人们会形容我非常固执、充满热情，或许还是个完美主义者，并且目标导向。

sentences.en: I think even to this day, it's how my friends would describe me.
sentences.zh: 我想即使到了今天，我的朋友们依然会这样描述我。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure everybody I've ever dated would say that I am ambitious for better or for worse.
sentences.zh: 我很确定我交往过的每一个人都会说，无论好坏，我都是一个野心勃勃的人。

sentences.en: And I certainly know that it's something that my parents feel particularly proud of, that they've kind of, you know, cultivated in me since I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 而且我当然知道，这是我父母感到特别自豪的一点，因为这在某种程度上是我从小就被他们培养出来的。

sentences.en: And I think ambition alongside a good dose of luck has definitely gotten me a lot in my life so far.
sentences.zh: 我认为野心加上一点点运气，确实让我在迄今为止的人生中获得了很多成就。

sentences.en: You know, I've written a book and this podcast that you are literally listening to is on Netflix.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我写过一本书，而你们现在正在听的这个播客也在 Netflix 上线了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm not going to go on and on about, oh my God, everything that I've achieved and all these things, because that feels very arrogant.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我不想没完没了地谈论“天哪，我取得了什么成就”之类的，因为那感觉非常傲慢。

sentences.en: But I do think that I've taken for granted or as a given that if I want something in life,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，我一直把“如果我想要生活中的某样东西”视为理所当然，

sentences.en: I really don't find it that difficult to work hard for it and to be a little bit delusional about my ability to get it.
sentences.zh: 我真的不觉得为之努力工作有多难，而且对于自己实现目标的能力，我甚至有点盲目自信。

sentences.en: What I've come to realize though is the cost of that trait and how the only thing that ambition really gives you after a while is just more ambition
sentences.zh: 然而，我意识到这种特质的代价是，野心在一段时间后唯一能带给你的就是更多的野心，

sentences.en: and a greater fear of inadequacy or a greater fear that you are not living up to your own expectations.
sentences.zh: 以及对自身不足的更大恐惧，或者担心自己无法达到自己期望的更大恐惧。

sentences.en: And I think it creates this void that just at some stage cannot be filled by any more accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 我认为它创造了一个空洞，在某个阶段，任何成就都无法填补它。

sentences.en: And it also comes with the cost that is more than just work.
sentences.zh: 而且它带来的代价不仅仅是工作上的。

sentences.en: You know, your relationships suffer, your sense of personality kind of disappears.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的人际关系会受损，你的个性感会逐渐消失。

sentences.en: You feel very guilty about not being productive.
sentences.zh: 你会因为没有产出而感到非常内疚。

sentences.en: And I think if we're being honest, it kind of just cannibalizes all other aspects of your life and all other aspects of who you are until it is the only thing that you are.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，它几乎吞噬了你生活的其他方面，以及你作为人的其他特质，直到它成为你唯一的标签。

sentences.en: I think it's very hard and it gets very hard to know who you are beyond your ambition or beyond your productivity the more you lean into it and the more that you kind of see it
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你越是沉溺于野心，越是将其视为你所能提供给世界或自己的最伟大的东西时，就越难认清野心之外的自己，或者说认清生产力之外的自己。

sentences.en: as the greatest thing that you have to offer the world or yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天想谈谈这个话题。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about it today.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我是如何意识到我的野心可能并不是我以为的那种朋友，我们如何能在没有野心的情况下发现真实的自我，

sentences.en: I want to talk about how I've come to the realization that my ambition might not be the friend that I thought it was, how we can discover who we are without our ambition,
sentences.zh: 以及我们最初是如何陷入这种“成就情结”的。

sentences.en: and just how we get wrapped up in this accomplishment complex to begin with.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，是的，我们该如何一起摆脱它，你和我。

sentences.en: And I don't know, yeah, how are we going to get out of it together, you and I.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这一期节目感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So I'm very excited for this episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很私人的话题。

sentences.en: It's a personal one.
sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢。

sentences.en: I hope you enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们进入野心那复杂的心理学世界吧。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into the complicated psychology of ambition.
sentences.zh: 所以我想先谈谈我与野心的关系是如何随着时间发展的，从童年到青少年，再到现在的成年，

sentences.en: So I want to begin with kind of talking about how my own relationship with ambition has developed over time from when I was a child to a teenager to now being an adult
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得这是一个熟悉且相当容易引起共鸣的故事，特别是如果你小时候也是个优等生，或者你是家里的长子、长女，

sentences.en: because I do think that it's a familiar and fairly relatable story, particularly if you yourself were a high achiever as a kid or you are the eldest child, the eldest daughter
sentences.zh: 或者你来自那种特别强调成就感的家庭。

sentences.en: in your family or you came from a particular kind of family where there was a real message of accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 关于野心以及心理学中如何谈论它，有一点需要了解，那就是野心被视为一种独特的人类人格特质。

sentences.en: Something to know about ambition and how it's spoken about specifically in psychology is that ambition is seen as a personality trait that is distinctly human.
sentences.zh: 其他哺乳动物和其他动物，它们可能想要权力、控制权、领导地位或资源，但没有其他生物会渴望人类似乎想要的那种成功，

sentences.en: Other mammals and other animals, like, they may want power, they may want control or leadership or resources, but no other creature wants the kind of success
sentences.zh: 那不仅仅是资源，也不仅仅是希望被他人以某种方式看待。

sentences.en: that humans seem to want, which is more than just resources and more than just being seen in a certain way by others.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是关于名誉的考量。

sentences.en: It's more than reputational concerns.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是一种成就感，是对某件事的个人自豪感。

sentences.en: It's really a sense of achievement and it's a sense of personal pride in something.
sentences.zh: 我认为野心与我们人类对意义的追求，以及我们渴望感到重要、渴望感到自己有价值的愿望息息相关。

sentences.en: And I think ambition links back to our human search for meaning and our desire to feel important and like we matter.
sentences.zh: 我真的不认为这是其他动物会关注的事情。

sentences.en: And I just don't think that that's something that other animals seem to be preoccupied by.
sentences.zh: 特别是，我认为野心背后有一种感觉：如果我实现了这件事，我得到了这个，我做出了一番事业，我做出了让自己引以为傲的东西，

sentences.en: Particularly, I think with ambition, there is this sense that if I achieve this thing and I get this and I make something of myself and I make something that I'm proud of,
sentences.zh: 那么我就会变得重要，我就会有价值，我的生活就会有某种能被他人认可的目的，因此它会感觉更真实。

sentences.en: then I will be important and I will matter and my life will have some purpose that others can recognize and therefore it will feel more valid.
sentences.zh: 所以这很快就变得非常哲学化了。

sentences.en: So it gets very philosophical very quickly.
sentences.zh: 在心理学中，野心也与抱负（aspiration）不同。

sentences.en: Ambition in psychology as well is also different to aspiration.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为这一点很重要，因为抱负本身是想要超越自我，或者想要实现某个具体目标，或者实现一个梦想，

sentences.en: And I really think that this is important to know because aspiration on its own is wanting something bigger than yourself or wanting a specific goal or to realize a dream
sentences.zh: 这通常是相当健康的，它是一种单一的东西，只属于你，并为你提供结构和目标。

sentences.en: that is often quite healthy and it's a singular kind of thing and it's just for you and provides structure and purpose.
sentences.zh: 而野心是一种无处不在的特质，或者说是一种看待世界的方式，它实际上没有终点。

sentences.en: Ambition is this pervasive trait or way of being or seeing the world that literally has no end.
sentences.zh: 没有最终的目标。

sentences.en: There is no final goal.
sentences.zh: 没有最终的满足时刻。

sentences.en: There is no final moment of satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 野心的任务永远无法完成，我认为奖赏总是遥不可及的。

sentences.en: The task of ambition is never accomplished and I think the prize is always out of reach.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它有时在心理上如此困难。

sentences.en: And that is what makes it so kind of mentally difficult at times.
sentences.zh: 在某些文化中，我认为野心也与贪婪同义，它名声不好。

sentences.en: In some cultures I think ambition is very synonymous as well with greed and it gets a bad reputation.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上被视为一种恶习。

sentences.en: It's somewhat seen as a vice.
sentences.zh: 它被视为一种邪恶，我真的觉得随着年龄增长，我越来越理解这一点。

sentences.en: It's seen as an evil and I really think the older I've gotten the more I get that.
sentences.zh: 野心真的能让人变成他们本来的样子。

sentences.en: Ambition can really turn people into someone that they're not.
sentences.zh: 它会导致我们真正忽视他人。

sentences.en: It can cause us to really disregard others.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我见过这种情况。

sentences.en: I feel like I've seen it.
sentences.zh: 你也见过。

sentences.en: You've seen it.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，它会激发出我们自身丑陋的一面。

sentences.en: And there is no doubt that it brings out some ugly sides of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但我认为个人付出的代价也非常大。

sentences.en: But I think the personal cost is also really great.
sentences.zh: 当你长期喂养你的野心时，它在很多方面成为了你唯一的任务。

sentences.en: Feeding your ambition
sentences.zh: 无论通过什么途径，只要能喂养你的野心，你都会去做。

sentences.en: when you've done it for long enough becomes your sole task in many ways.
sentences.zh: 人们谈论它的方式是，你其实别无选择。

sentences.en: Whatever avenue you can feed your ambition through you will do so.
sentences.zh: 就像它是你与生俱来的东西一样。

sentences.en: And the way that it's spoken about is that you don't really have a choice.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的内在特质。

sentences.en: Like it's something that you are you're kind of born with.
sentences.zh: 我也认为它源于我们的成长方式，而且我也认为有时它演变成了一种应对机制或生存策略，用来对抗你年轻时的环境。

sentences.en: It's what we would call intrinsic.
sentences.zh: 我特别能从自己身上看到这一点。

sentences.en: I also think it comes from how we were raised and I also think that at times it evolves as a bit of a coping mechanism or a survival strategy against the circumstances
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，你知道，

sentences.en: of when you were younger.
sentences.zh: 我很确定，

sentences.en: And I see that particularly for myself.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，回顾我自己的自传式记忆，我一直有点这样，但我也认为小时候我更有抱负，是被好奇心和对事物的热爱所驱动的。

sentences.en: As I said you know
sentences.zh: 然后当我上高中时，那种状态就停止了，那时我变成了大写的“野心勃勃”，而不是小写的“有抱负”。

sentences.en: I'm fairly certain
sentences.zh: 我变得野心勃勃的原因是，我相信我将我的野心以及它能带给我的东西，视为一种补偿我内心深处极度不安全感的方式。

sentences.en: historically like looking into my own autobiographical memory like I've always somewhat been this way but I also think as a kid I was more aspirational and like driven by curiosity
sentences.zh: 我真的不合群，我真的觉得我没什么朋友，

sentences.en: and a love for things.
sentences.zh: 我之前在播客里说过，你知道，我非常孤独，而且我还是个……我不知道，我不喜欢说自己是个丑孩子，但没错，我小时候确实有点丑，而且是个怪孩子，我很古怪，对奇怪的事情感兴趣，而且我表现得过于热切，因为我没有朋友，我不认为这在社交上对我有什么帮助，

sentences.en: And then that kind of stopped when I got to high school and that's when I became ambitious with a capital A rather than aspirational with a lowercase a.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的非常想融入一个群体，而我很早就学到的是，你知道，如果我不能成为最受欢迎、最漂亮或最聪明的人，

sentences.en: And the reason I became ambitious is because I believe I saw my ambition and what it could bring me as a way to compensate for some really really deep insecurities.
sentences.zh: 至少我可以成为最努力工作的人，这本身就会带来它自己的回报。

sentences.en: I really didn't belong I really didn't feel like I had many friends
sentences.zh: 特别是，这绝对意味着有一群人会更喜欢你，那就是成年人。如果我野心勃勃且成就斐然，成年人会更关注我。你知道，我们整个学校系统以及我们生命的前 18 年，确实是以评分系统和排名系统为中心的，这个系统奖励孩子们的野心，却不给他们提供其他的功能方式。你知道，对于一周内能挤进最多课外活动的人有奖励，对于成为全 A 学生和学霸也有奖励，

sentences.en: I've spoken about this before on the podcast but you know I was very lonely I was also a pretty like I don't know like to say ugly kid but yeah I was a little ugly kid and I was
sentences.zh: 我作为一个青少年，真的沉迷于此。野心就像我的避风港，你知道，如果我无法控制别人如何看待我，或者我自己的感受，我至少可以依靠我的野心。

sentences.en: a weird kid and I was odd and I was interested in strange things and I was overzealous because I didn't have any friends and I don't think that really helped me socially either
sentences.zh: 它也是能让我摆脱我不想再待下去的环境的东西。你知道，我不觉得我真正适合我长大的地方，它确实把我带到了一所遥远的好学校。当我做到这一点时，我心想，这才是我的生活真正开始的地方。这里也存在着一种深刻且不可避免的联系，

sentences.en: because I just really wanted to be part of a group and what I learned pretty early on was that you know if I couldn't be the most liked or the hottest or the smartest
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，野心、赞美和自尊之间存在着联系。心理学家有一个术语，叫“有条件的自尊”，这是一种基于他人认可的自尊，

sentences.en: at least I could be the person who works the hardest and that in itself will bring its own kind of reward.
sentences.zh: 特别是因为你在某一件事情或某个领域非常擅长，而这件事情对你来说感觉特别重要或有价值。这两位心理学家，他们非常了不起，我强烈推荐他们的作品，他们的名字是

sentences.en: In particular it will definitely mean that one group of people specifically will like you more which is adults adults will pay more attention to me if I'm ambitious
sentences.zh: Jennifer Crocker 和 Connie Wilf，他们来自密歇根大学，

sentences.en: and accomplished you know our whole schooling system and the first 18 years of our life really is centralized around a grading system and a ranking system and a system that rewards
